page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is a general-purpose virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.mn4 family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY core with 2 threads per core, running on a KVM hypervisor. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz and has a shared CPU allocation. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1090.78, and the multi-core score is 2067.18, both falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show 158.75 GB/sec for small cached blocks, but this drops significantly to 16.93 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Cryptographic and compression tests also reflect lower-tier performance, with a passmark CPU encryption score of 821.33 and a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 18.81 GB/sec.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest performance profile, the ecs.mn4.large is positioned as a cost-efficient option for entry-level workloads. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic text processing, small-scale development or testing environments, and low-traffic database operations that do not require sustained high-performance compute resources.
